method: Direct visual inspection of all original PNG captures with image viewing tools; exact filenames, byte counts and SHA-256 values matched the published browser receipt before inspection. No image transformations, browser reruns, or source edits.
assessment: No blocking visual regression established within this satellite and source-credit scope.
sharedFindings: Photo coverage is present across land and water without the former country cutout or selected-area tint.
The compact credits are readable on dark ocean, dark land and pale terrain; no clipping or collision with controls, sheet or viewport edge was observed.
EOX and Blue Marble credit/status changes agree with the imagery shown.
Mobile and desktop controls and Russian labels remain readable.
